About

Bryan “sp33dsk8r” Taylor is a passionate speedskater and cyclist based in Katy, Texas. A dedicated recreational and fitness skater, he trains regularly on FR recreational and EdgeTek carbon skates and enjoys cycling on both upright and recumbent setups. With a strong background in endurance cycling, Bryan has completed multiple MS150 rides to support MS research.

Whether on skates or his Cruzbike Vendetta V20, he’s committed to fitness, community, and pushing personal limits. Bryan believes in the power of movement for physical and mental health and loves sharing knowledge with the Houston skating and cycling community.
